query: INSERT INTO bear_skills_manifest(bear_id,skill_name,skill_version,source,content_hash,applies_to_profiles,catalog_entry_id,enabled,attached_by_user_id) SELECT $1,$3,$4,'imported_package',$5,$6,$7,false,$2 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_bear WHERE bear_id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND lower(btrim(role))='admin') ON CONFLICT(bear_id,skill_name,skill_version) DO NOTHING
